job.title: Senior Legal Secretary - Top tier Firm - Projects & Energy
job.description:
The Opportunity
An opportunity to join a globally renowned, top-tier law firm with low staff turnover, excellent induction and training, and strong career progression opportunities. The firm has a welcoming and inclusive culture, with extensive resources and a strong investment in technology, systems, and procedures.

The Role
This role sits within the firm’s Projects and Energy team, where you will support Partners only, with no lawyer support required. You will also have access to an administration team to assist with basic administrative tasks.
Your day-to-day responsibilities will include:

  • Diary and email management
  • Client management
  • Practice management
  • Billing

About You
We are looking for an experienced legal support professional looking to step up into an EA-style role. You will have experience supporting at least two Partners simultaneously. We are open to candidates from any practice area background. We are not looking for law students or recent graduates.
What You Will Get
A market-leading salary package of up to $110,000, depending on experience. The firm also offers up to two days of working from home once you are settled into the role, along with a generous benefits package, including 26 weeks of paid parental leave, gym membership, and other benefits.

job.title: Legal Secretary - Wills & Estates
job.description:
If you’re a Legal Secretary who enjoys litigation, complex matters and working closely with senior lawyers, this could be a great next move!

When “excellent sense of humour” is actually listed in the job description… you know you’re onto a good one.

The Firm
A well-established commercial law firm in Sydney CBD with a strong reputation for its work and a genuinely down to earth culture. Professional, collaborative and people focused, with a great team environment.

The Role
You’ll support a small team across complex Wills & Estates litigation, working closely with two Partners and several solicitors. The role will involve:
• Managing diaries, correspondence and day to day legal support
• Preparing and formatting legal documents and correspondence
• File and matter management
• Court and litigation administration
• Liaising with clients and other parties
• Supporting the team across a varied and interesting caseload

The Benefits
• Up to $120,000 package, depending on experience
• CBD location
• Supportive, professional and informal environment
• Direct exposure to Partners and senior lawyers
• A firm that genuinely invests in and develops its people

If you're an experienced Legal Secretary with litigation experience and looking for a role where you can get stuck into interesting work without the big-firm attitude, we would love to hear from you.

Applicants must have full Australian working rights (Australian Citizenship or Permanent Residency). Unfortunately, student visas will not be considered.
